title: All provinces to experience ‘drought’ by end of March 2027 — Solidum
summary: All 82 provinces in the country will experience drought by the end of March next year with the anticipated ‘very strong’ El Niño, Department of Science and Technology Secretary Renato Solidum said…

blocks.text: All 82 provinces in the country will experience drought by the end of March next year with the anticipated ‘very strong’ El Niño, Department of Science and Technology Secretary Renato Solidum said Monday.
